claim: Choose the authentication scheme from the actual application (Bearer/OIDC for SPA to API, cookies for server-rendered apps, Identity for local accounts, external OIDC/OAuth for delegated identity).
A Decision Request must present a title, Context, Options, Recommendation, Blocked work and Proceeding-with work.
excerpt:
Stop the Reserved part of the work and present:

```text
Decision Request: <short title>

Context: <what requires the decision; which accepted decision, rule, or
         product source it touches>
Options: <realistic alternatives, including staying within current decisions,
         with trade-offs and reversal cost>
Recommendation: <preferred option and why>
Blocked: <work that cannot continue until this is decided>
Proceeding with: <compliant non-Reserved work continuing meanwhile, or "nothing">
```

claim: Use bounded iteration and stop and reassess under concrete conditions (same root failure survives, new unrelated failures, incompatible toolchain, missing infrastructure, unresolvable packages, undeterminable behavior); do not repeat failed guesses.
Async methods are expected to end with Async, but detection only covers async-modified methods and no framework/interface contract exemption is encoded.
excerpt:
# Naming: async methods end with Async (framework/interface contracts may differ)
dotnet_naming_rule.async_methods_end_in_async.symbols = async_methods
dotnet_naming_rule.async_methods_end_in_async.style = end_in_async
dotnet_naming_rule.async_methods_end_in_async.severity = suggestion
dotnet_naming_symbols.async_methods.applicable_kinds = method
dotnet_naming_symbols.async_methods.required_modifiers = async
dotnet_naming_style.end_in_async.required_suffix = Async
dotnet_naming_style.end_in_async.capitalization = pascal_case
